contracts.source: Simulations Plus press release: Simulations Plus Advances Agentic Drug Development with (06-23-2026)
contracts.signal: Simulations Plus is building the agentic layer of Composer, its AI-native platform for model-informed drug development, using the NVIDIA BioNeMo Agent Toolkit, expanding the companies' collaboration announced in May 2026 on GPU-accelerated simulation and AI-assisted modeling. Composer agents are expected to use NVIDIA Nemotron Parse to extract and structure information from scientific literature, and the companies are together advancing nvQSP, a collaborative development initiative on CUDA-optimized ordinary differential equation (ODE) solvers for quantitative systems pharmacology run on NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure; these capabilities are being incorporated into Composer.
contracts.type: software toolkit integration and co-development collaboration
